HH, Rte. 142 Proposed Improvement: Bridge Replacements (P0256, P0258, S0523) Right of Way: Consultant to provide title commitments for affected properties. Environmental: RES submittals at milestones and informational support as requested. Surveying: Perform all survey pickup work. Professional land surveying to establish land corners, property lines, monument new right of way, prepare boundary surveys and write deeds as necessary. Roadway Design: Consultant to prepare all preliminary, right of way, final roadway design and plan preparation as necessary to submit final roadway plans, specifications, and estimates. (PS&E). Hydraulic analysis of all drainage structures, reporting and coordination with any drainage districts, municipalities, railroad and other government agencies.
